zh.title: 中英生命科学与文化交流
zh.summary: 中英生命科学与文化交流活动：将现场安排与人员协作纳入整体统筹。
zh.preview: 交流活动需要把参与人员与现场安排组织到一起。Vivian Adventure 的职责是活动整体统筹，重点落在现场与人员之间的衔接。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 承担活动整体统筹，将现场安排与人员协作作为相互关联的工作处理。现场需求通过人员协调落实，人员安排也需要与活动现场相匹配。
zh.context: 这是一项以中英生命科学与文化交流为主题的活动。本案的执行任务围绕活动组织展开，为参与者的现场交流提供配套安排。

narrativeSections.heading: 交流背后的组织工作
narrativeSections.text: 项目的核心是交流活动本身。我们的工作落在组织层面：把现场安排与参与执行的人员联系起来，让活动内容有对应的执行支持。整体统筹的范围在本案中体现为现场与人员两条工作线。

outcomes: 本案形成了活动现场与人员协作的组织交付，体现正式交流活动的统筹能力。

en.title: Sino–UK Life Sciences & Cultural Exchange
en.summary: Event coordination for Sino-UK life sciences and cultural exchange, connecting people with on-site arrangements.
en.preview: An exchange event needs its people and practical arrangements to work together. Vivian Adventure’s scope was overall event coordination, centred on the relationship between the site and those involved.
en.role: Vivian Adventure undertook overall event coordination, linking on-site arrangements with people liaison. Each part of the work informed the other: practical requirements needed people in place, and people needed arrangements that matched the event.
en.context: The event focused on Sino-UK life sciences and cultural exchange. The production assignment concerned the organisation behind that meeting and the arrangements supporting it on site.

narrativeSections.heading: The organisation behind the exchange
narrativeSections.text: The exchange itself was the purpose of the event. Our contribution was its practical organisation: connecting on-site arrangements with the people involved in execution. These were the two linked strands of the overall coordination scope.

outcomes: The delivery comprised the event’s on-site organisation and people coordination, demonstrating practical coordination for a formal exchange event.
